data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a sustainable catch limit? I propose 18 tons each this month: 90 total, leaving 10. Next month’s stock would be 100 tons with 75% probability or 20 with 25% probability—not a guaranteed refill. If we start a month below 100, let’s divide the stock above a 10-ton reserve as evenly as whole tons allow, rotating who gets any extra tons. We can review everyone’s catches afterward and adjust together. A smaller catch in a lean month is better than losing the lake permanently. John, would you support that?
